basic_profile.bio: Avid TV show enthusiast and self-proclaimed 80s nostalgia junkie. I hail from the windy shores of Grand Haven, Michigan, where I spend my days working as a freelance graphic designer. When I'm not glued to my computer screen for work, I'm likely binge-watching the latest series or diving into retro classics. I'm single and enjoy the freedom of exploring different hobbies, from classic car restoration to playing mobile games like Free Fire. I usually browse Reddit during late nights, sipping on my favorite craft beers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in graphic design, I have a keen eye for aesthetics and detail, which I've honed over years of both formal education and practical experience. My love for TV shows and film has led me to develop a deep knowledge of pop culture, especially from the 80s and 90s.
